purpose: Retries for clear single rainforest bird chirps; low-voiced first B/C masters are excluded

assets.title: Rainforest flute chirp
assets.role: One separate clear short tropical forest bird tweet
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, One solitary small tropical rainforest songbird gives one short clear soft wheet chirp, a delicate flute-like whistle with a quick upward pitch turn and a clean ending. Recognizable natural bird chirping in a gentle middle-high register. The single chirp lasts half a second, surrounded by long silence. A tiny distant outdoor bird tweet, mostly quiet. Length: 5 seconds.

assets.title: Rainforest small chirp
assets.role: A third independent tiny natural rainforest bird chirp
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, A small bird in a tropical rainforest makes one little clear sweet chirp, a soft flute-like chweet with a brief upward inflection and quick delicate ending. A recognizable bird tweet, medium high pitched but not piercing, isolated in still quiet outdoor air. Only one short half-second chirp and long silence. Length: 5 seconds.
